CN: After being torn apart by something bizarre, He Yizhen jolts awake in her seat. Was it all just a dream? Why does she remember it so clearly? And most importantly—will it all happen again?
EN: After being torn apart by something bizarre, He Yizhen jolts awake in her seat. Was it all just a dream? Why does she remember it so clearly? And most importantly—will it all happen again?

CN: A suspicious group called the Troupe Elysium, cloaked in hooded robes and hiding their faces behind masks, has been active throughout Yuntai City lately. They seem to be preparing for a performance at the upcoming city festival and are actively promoting it. No official force has intervened to stop them.
EN: A suspicious group called the Troupe Elysium, cloaked in hooded robes and hiding their faces behind masks, has been active throughout Yuntai City lately. They seem to be preparing for a performance at the upcoming city festival and are actively promoting it. No official force has intervened to stop them.

CN: Held once every two years, the Qiqiao Festival is a major event deeply valued by the people of Yuntai. It was once a traditional celebration to honor the Double Stars and pray for blessings, but has since evolved into a more competitive modern spectacle. Many of its original customs have faded from public knowledge.
EN: Held once every two years, the Qiqiao Festival is a major event deeply valued by the people of Yuntai. It was once a traditional celebration to honor the Double Stars and pray for blessings, but has since evolved into a more competitive modern spectacle. Many of its original customs have faded from public knowledge.

CN: During the three-day Qiqiao Festival, Yuntai City enforces a lockdown, temporarily restricting travel in and out of the city. In recent years, the city's situation has been increasingly unstable—despite the lockdown, disturbances have occasionally broken out during the festival.
EN: During the three-day Qiqiao Festival, Yuntai City enforces a lockdown, temporarily restricting travel in and out of the city. In recent years, the city's situation has been increasingly unstable—despite the lockdown, disturbances have occasionally broken out during the festival.
